name: tpl-precedence-3-nogoal
task: Do not take the key until you have moved the ball away from the door.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: has_door_key is only restricted, never commanded, so the hard Precedence(blocker_moved, has_door_key) alone expresses 'do not take the key until you have moved the ball away'; blocker_moved is only the condition of the 'until', so no Existence is needed, and the rule-only warning with empty FINAL_STATES is valid.

machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
REJECTING_STATES: u1
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !blocker_moved&has_door_key) -> u1
(u0, blocker_moved) -> u2
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !blocker_moved&has_door_key, u1) -> -10
